deep.reconstruction:
Context: on the previous pages Riemann studies an unbranched λ-fold cyclic covering of a Riemann surface of genus ρ. It is built by cutting along a_ρ and stacking λ copies; the sketch on this page shows exactly this, a column of boxes labelled a_1^{(1)}, a_1^{(2)}, …, a_1^{(ν)} next to u_1. On the cover the cuts a_ν, b_ν (ν<ρ) multiply into a^α_ν, b^α_ν. The normalized integrals w^α_ν are recombined with λ-th roots of unity α (α^λ=1) into v^κ_ν = Σ_α w^α_ν α^{α g^κ}. The theta series of the cover then splits into a part in u and parts in the v^κ (a Prym-type decomposition). This page is scratch work for that programme, written out for genus 2.

(1) Period table for genus 2 (normalized first-kind integrals u_1, u_2):
- u_1 has period πi on a_1, 0 on a_2, a_{11} on b_1 and a_{12} on b_2.
- u_2 has period 0 on a_1, πi on a_2, a_{12} on b_1 and a_{22} on b_2.
- The period matrix is symmetric (a_{21}=a_{12}).

(2) General period / value of u along an arbitrary closed path: u_μ ↦ u_μ + n_μ πi + Σ_ν m_ν a_{μν}, i.e.
- u_1 + n_1 πi + m_1 a_{11} + m_2 a_{12}
- u_2 + n_2 πi + m_1 a_{21} + m_2 a_{22}.
Riemann wrote m_1 a_{11} in the second line (slip; see errors).

(3) The line 'u_1 … v_1^k = α^{n g^k} v_1^k' records how the eigen-combinations v^k behave under the deck transformation (passing from sheet α to sheet α+n). Since v^κ_ν = Σ_α w^α_ν α^{α g^κ}, shifting the sheet index by n multiplies v^κ by a root of unity α^{±n g^κ}; the sign depends on the direction of the shift. So the v^κ are eigenvectors of the cyclic group action, while u (κ=0) is invariant. Inversion (from the previous page; my restatement): λ w^α_ν = u_ν + Σ_κ α^{-α g^κ} v^κ_ν, using Σ_{κ} α^{(α-β)g^κ} = λ δ_{αβ} when the κ include 0.

(4) First a cancelled product, then ∏_{ν=1}^{λ^2} ϑ(v + a^{(ν)}). This is a product of theta functions over λ^2 translates. The natural reading (mine) is that the a^{(ν)} are the λ-division points (n πi + m a)/λ, 0≤n,m<λ, of a one-dimensional period lattice. Such a product is, up to an exponential factor, a theta function with argument λv and λ-multiplied modulus: the classical multiplication/isogeny relation, here linking the theta of the base to that of the cover.

(5) 'v_1/λ … πi/λ': variables and periods are divided by λ. This is the normalization V = v/λ, B = b/λ introduced on the previous page, so the v-thetas get standard period πi again.

No complete derivation is carried out on this page.
errors: Second line of the general period: Riemann wrote u_2 + n_2πi + m_1 a_{1,1} + m_2 a_{2,2}; by his own table it should be m_1 a_{1,2} (= a_{2,1}), not m_1 a_{1,1}. A copying slip.

The line v_1^k = α^{n g^k} v_1^k is literally an identity only with the left side read as the transformed function (v_1^k after the deck shift). The notation is elliptic, and the sign of the exponent depends on the shift direction.
The product ∏ϑ(v+a^{(ν)}) is stated without the a^{(ν)} being specified or a resulting identity given; its intended meaning (division-point translates) is inferred.

results.what: Normalized period table and symmetric period matrix for genus 2 first-kind integrals (periods πi on a-cuts, a_{μν} on b-cuts)
results.modern_name: Normalized period matrix (Riemann bilinear relations, symmetry)

results.what: Eigen-decomposition of the integrals on an unbranched λ-fold cyclic cover: v^κ = Σ_α w^α α^{α g^κ} transform by roots of unity under the deck group
results.modern_name: Decomposition of the Jacobian of a cyclic étale cover; Prym variety / Prym differentials
results.usually_credited_to: Prym 1869 (double covers), Wirtinger 1895, Schottky–Jung 1909; Mumford 1974 (modern Prym theory)

results.what: Product of λ^2 translated theta functions ∏ϑ(v+a^{(ν)}) over division points, with periods rescaled by 1/λ
results.modern_name: Theta multiplication / isogeny formula (theta of an isogenous abelian variety)

deep.surprise_reason: The page itself is fragmentary scratch: a genus-2 period table, the general period (with a slip), the root-of-unity action of the deck group, and a product over λ^2 theta translates. Its interest lies in the surrounding Nachlass programme on theta functions of unbranched cyclic covers (a precursor of Prym/Schottky–Jung theory), which is somewhat known through Prym and Riemann's circle. This page adds no new result beyond that context.

checkable.sympy: lam=3; a=exp(2*pi*I/lam); [simplify(sum(a**((al-be)*k) for k in range(lam))) for al in range(lam) for be in range(lam)]
checkable.asserts: Orthogonality of λ-th roots of unity: Σ_k α^{(α-β)k} = λ δ_{αβ}. This justifies the inversion λ w^α = u + Σ_κ α^{-α g^κ} v^κ.

checkable.sympy: lam=3; a=exp(2*pi*I/lam); w=symbols('w0:3'); v=[sum(w[j]*a**(j*k) for j in range(lam)) for k in range(lam)]; [simplify(sum(v[k]*a**(-al*k) for k in range(lam)) - lam*w[al]) for al in range(lam)]
checkable.asserts: u + Σ_{κ≠0} v^κ α^{-ακ} = λ w^α, with u = v^0 = Σ w^α (all entries should simplify to 0).

checkable.sympy: lam=3; a=exp(2*pi*I/lam); w=symbols('w0:3'); v=lambda ww,k: sum(ww[j]*a**(j*k) for j in range(lam)); ws=[w[(j+1)%lam] for j in range(lam)]; [simplify(v(ws,k)-a**(-k)*v(w,k)) for k in range(lam)]
checkable.asserts: Under the cyclic deck shift (sheet j → j+1), v^κ is multiplied by the root of unity α^{-κ} (entries simplify to 0).
The genus-2 period matrix in the table is symmetric. The correct general period of u_2 is n_2*pi*I + m1*a12 + m2*a22.

transcription_corrections: Line 4 (general period of u_2): the manuscript reads m_1 a_{1,1}. This is Riemann's slip, not a transcription error; mathematically it should be a_{1,2}.
Third block: the leading symbol is u_1 (or u_k) standing alone, followed by v_1^k = α^{n_ν g^k} v_1^k; the subscript on the right-hand v is 1.
Cancelled line: it appears to be ∏ ϑ(v + a^{(ν)}) with an extra subscript or superscript, struck through; the uncancelled line has limits ν=1 to ν=λ^2.
Sketch: a vertical stack of boxes with labels a_1^{(1)}, a_1^{(2)}, a_1^{(3)}? …, a_1^{(ν)}? and u_1 to the left. It depicts the λ-fold cyclic cover obtained by repeating the cut a_1.
